items: Start with the manual processes and bottlenecks already costing you time or money, such as repetitive guest questions or slow review replies, before you look at any AI tool.
Your first AI projects should be repetitive, data-heavy and easy to measure, so you can prove value quickly with low risk.
Pilot in a few locations for a few weeks against baseline metrics like response time and CSAT, then scale across more locations only if the pilot works.
Choose tools that plug into your existing systems and support multi-location workflows, and train managers to act on what the AI recommends.
